title: Not WORTH in the educational Value and fun Value
text: The first one came in December and it looked uninteresting and felt there should be better activity suggestions but wanted to give another chance.  Just received the 2nd envelope of sheets of stickers, an imitation coin and a rock. Can't imagine any kids 6-10 will be intrigued by these cheap trinkets!  As i was looking forward to introducing different places to our granddaughter, thus I was extremely disappointed.  Only thing positive is the title "Little Passports world"
label: negative
